descriptionChirho: Spatial direction toward a higher position, indicating upward movement or orientation.
Indicates origin or source from a higher position, used with preposition min to express 'from above' or 'from the top of.'
Locative sense expressing a static position above or on top of something.
Used with conjunctive waw in the idiom 'from X and upward/onward' to indicate an open-ended range of age, measure, or continuation.
Combines conjunctive waw with prepositional min to express 'and from above,' indicating an additional source from a higher position.
